Which statement about bases is correct?
A
All bases dissolve in water to form solutions with a pH greater than 7.
B
Bases react with ammonium salts to form ammonia gas.
C
All oxides of elements in Period 3 of the Periodic Table are bases.
D
Bases react with acids to form a salt and hydrogen.
